_note: The small tool set the router eval targets. Every time or date argument is the user's own words (a span); code resolves it, never the model. Domains are what the embedding router picks between.

parameters.query: string, what to play, as said
parameters.kind: artist | album | song | playlist | genre | radio (optional)

parameters.action: pause | resume | skip | previous | stop | louder | quieter | set_volume

lights.name: light_set
lights.description: Turn a light or room on or off, or change it.

parameters.target: string (optional), the light or room as said; 'all' for everything; leave out when no room is named (code uses the device's room)

inventory.name: inventory_adjust
inventory.description: Something was used up or added, by a count.

inventory.name: inventory_mark
inventory.description: Set a bulk item's level when there is no count.

inventory.name: inventory_set
inventory.description: Record how many there are now (a count, not a change).

inventory.name: inventory_find
inventory.description: Where something is kept, or how many are left.

inventory.name: tool_status
inventory.description: Log an exception for a tool. Normal borrowing in the house is assumed returned and is not logged.

lists.name: list_add
lists.description: Add to the shopping list or the to-do list.

lists.name: list_remove
lists.description: Cross off: bought, done, or no longer needed.

parameters.when: string span, e.g. today, tomorrow, this week, friday

calendar.name: calendar_add
calendar.description: Put an event on the calendar.

parameters.title: string
parameters.when: string span with the date and time as said
now | today | tonight | tomorrow | this week | weekend

alerts.name: alerts_read
alerts.description: What alerts or reminders are pending.

alerts.name: alert_act
alerts.description: Deal with the alert that just went off.

outcomes.call: exactly the expected call; accept lists other calls that also pass
outcomes.ask: no call; the device must ask a clarifying question instead (ambiguous target, missing amount, unclear list)
outcomes.none: no call; nothing to do (chit-chat, thanks, out of scope)
